state.description: Replace Thomaston 230/115kV 285MVA auto transformers C and D with 400MVA auto transformers. Install high side breakers to meet the 230kV bus differential standards and redesign 230kV bus to a breaker and a half configuration.

q.instructions: Is this town a fair approximate location for the endpoint?

criteria.true: The endpoint is named after this town (e.g. 'Bluffton' substation near Bluffton, SC).
criteria.false: The name only shares a word with the town or clearly refers to something elsewhere (e.g. 'Union Pier' is not Union, SC).
